ontology_notes.v2_split_note: metal_dependent_hydrolase is the coarse v1 umbrella (kept for the frozen-702 and pre-2026-06-11 expansion rows). Its v2 sub-families separate the distinct reaction-center bond change + metal architecture: metallopeptidase (peptide C-N), metallophosphoesterase_nuclease (phosphodiester P-O, two-metal), metallophosphomonoesterase (phosphomonoester P-O, di-metal), metallo_amidohydrolase_deaminase (non-peptide amide/amidine C-N). New bronze is sourced to the sub-families, not the umbrella.

interpretation.deployment_decision: Fail closed for atlas-engine fusion on the current-57 cofactor surface. Either pin/replay the intended June 9 router/fingerprint surface, or build a new precision channel/fusion rule with a new preregistered train/cal done bar before any heldout-facing read.
interpretation.headline: The documented v1 metal-umbrella projection explains a large part of the current-57 exact-match drift, but no current-57 threshold meets the trusted June 9 cofactor precision bar on calibration.

pre_registered_done_bar.reference_note: June 9 trusted cofactor precision bar: keep the fused calibration primary recovery while not exceeding the recalibrated 0.44 threshold-dial OOS false positives.

selection_rule.candidate_rule: A current-57 threshold-only cofactor precision contract is eligible only if a calibration threshold keeps at least the trusted June 9 fused primary count under the documented v1 metal-umbrella compatibility projection and does not exceed the trusted June 9 threshold-dial OOS false-positive count.
